brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm caps (market says ₹0.85–0.95 typical, but higher volume unlocks headroom to ₹0.65–0.80), then trade 30-day payment for a further cut — freeing ₹2.25 L cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at our annual volume (₹27.42 L spend).
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking price for this cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The market verdict says 'modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — we are a ₹27.42 L annual customer, so we should land in that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days after receipt to 30 days, in exchange for a price cut equal to the time-value of money (roughly 15 days' interest on each invoice).
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.25 L cash freed up for us if we move to 30 days.

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. That means the plan leans on our own data — our ₹27.42 L spend is real money to a private LLP — and on lining up a credible second source. We have five strong alternates (three listed giants, two large private converters), so we can push on price and terms without risking supply. Lead with the market evidence and the faster-payment trade; if they push back hard, offer to qualify Manjushree or Mold-Tek in parallel.

evidence.point: Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
Market verdict: 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — we buy ₹27.42 L a year, so we qualify for that lower band.
HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg — raw-material cost has not spiked.
Moving from 45 days to 30 days frees ₹2.25 L cash for us — that's the value of faster payment we can trade for a price cut.
We have no visibility into their finances (not public), so we rely on our spend size and backup sources for leverage.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100) — a strong, qualified second source.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma closures); strong and profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging supplier — broad capability across bottles and caps.

risks: No financials published — we can't see if they're healthy or stretched, so watch for any supply hiccups and have an alternate ready to onboard fast.
If they refuse ₹0.65–0.80, the typical market band is ₹0.85–0.95 — know that floor before you walk in.
Faster payment (30 days) is worth real money to them only if their cash is tight; if they're flush, they may not value it enough to cut price — be ready to bundle it with volume commitment instead.

We found six manufacturer/recycler leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) in public research — all are leads to qualify (verify capability and price before sending an RFQ), not approved sources yet.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to true-up our pricing to the market — the open asking price for these caps is ₹0.85–0.95 typical, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at our volume — and we're ready to pay you faster in exchange for landing in that lower band.
